d: IJSBA (International Jet Sports Boat Association INC) will be sponsoring the 45th Annual IJSBA PWC World Championships on October 3 – 11, 2026 in Lake Havasu, AZ.  The event will consist of approximately 400 total participants with never more than 22 at a time in a closed course race near the Crazy Horse campgrounds that is approximately 1 and ½ along Pittsburg point and quarter mile wide.  Mariners are advised to exercise due caution while transiting the area.  For more information or comments, contact Scott Frazier at 650-302-6762.
